# Bare-metal (newlib, no OS, single-thread) build with the Andes
# nds64le-elf-newlib toolchain. Runs on Andes QEMU (andes_ae350) via
# semihosting. Only n_threads=1 is supported at runtime.
#
# Usage:
#   export ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT=/path/to/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d
#   cmake -B build-rv64-baremetal \
#       -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/riscv64-andes-elf-newlib-gcc.cmake \
#       -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
#       -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
#       -DGGML_NATIVE=OFF -DGGML_OPENMP=OFF \
#       -DGGML_RVV=ON -DGGML_RV_ZFH=ON -DGGML_RV_ZVFH=ON \
#       -DGGML_RV_ZBA=ON -DGGML_RV_ZICBOP=ON \
#       -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
#       -DLLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF
#   cmake --build build-rv64-baremetal --target llama-simple -j

set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Generic)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR riscv64)

if (DEFINED ENV{ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT})
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH $ENV{ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT} ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT env must be defined (path to nds64le-elf-newlib toolchain)")
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER   ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-gcc)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-g++)
set(CMAKE_AR           ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-ar)
set(CMAKE_RANLIB       ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-ranlib)
set(CMAKE_STRIP        ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-strip)

set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH "${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/riscv64-elf")
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)

# -D_POSIX_THREADS unlocks newlib's pthread declarations; the single-thread
# implementations come from the shim libpthread.a built below.
set(ANDES_ARCH_FLAGS "-march=rv64gcv_zfh_zvfh_zba_zicbop -mabi=lp64d -D_POSIX_THREADS=200809L")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS   "${ANDES_ARCH_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${ANDES_ARCH_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")

# Build the single-thread pthread shim once so find_package(Threads) and the
# final link resolve -lpthread against it.
set(ANDES_SHIM_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/andes-baremetal)
if (NOT EXISTS ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/libpthread.a)
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -march=rv64gcv_zfh_zvfh_zba_zicbop -mabi=lp64d
                -D_POSIX_THREADS=200809L -O2 -c ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/pthread-shim.c
                -o ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/pthread-shim.o
        RESULT_VARIABLE ANDES_SHIM_CC_RC)
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_AR} rcs ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/libpthread.a ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/pthread-shim.o
        RESULT_VARIABLE ANDES_SHIM_AR_RC)
    if (NOT ANDES_SHIM_CC_RC EQUAL 0 OR NOT ANDES_SHIM_AR_RC EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "failed to build bare-metal pthread shim in ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()

set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "-L${ANDES_SHIM_DIR} ${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")

#       -DGGML_RVV=ON -DGGML_RV_ZFH=ON -DGGML_RV_ZVFH=ON \
#       -DGGML_RV_ZBA=ON -DGGML_RV_ZICBOP=ON \
#       -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
#       -DLLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF
#   cmake --build build-rv64-baremetal --target llama-simple -j

set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Generic)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR riscv64)

if (DEFINED ENV{ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT})
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH $ENV{ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT} ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT env must be defined (path to nds64le-elf-newlib toolchain)")
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER   ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-gcc)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-g++)
set(CMAKE_AR           ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-ar)
set(CMAKE_RANLIB       ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-ranlib)
set(CMAKE_STRIP        ${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/bin/riscv64-elf-strip)

set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH "${ANDES_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT}/riscv64-elf")
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)

# -D_POSIX_THREADS unlocks newlib's pthread declarations; the single-thread

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS   "${ANDES_ARCH_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${ANDES_ARCH_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")

# Build the single-thread pthread shim once so find_package(Threads) and the
# final link resolve -lpthread against it.
set(ANDES_SHIM_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/andes-baremetal)
if (NOT EXISTS ${ANDES_SHIM_DIR}/libpthread.a)
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -march=rv64gcv_zfh_zvfh_zba_zicbop -mabi=lp64d

endif()
